mapper.select:
WITH p AS ( SELECT coalesce(pklt_cpcty, 0) AS cap, emd_cd, ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(lot::float8, lat::float8), 4326), 5179) AS g5 FROM parking.tb_pblpklt WHERE lat BETWEEN 33.10 AND 33.65 AND lot BETWEEN 126.10 AND 127.00 ), sup AS ( SELECT floor(ST_X(g5) / #{gridSz}::float8)::bigint AS gx, floor(ST_Y(g5) / #{gridSz}::float8)::bigint AS gy, sum(cap)::int AS pklt_cpcty_sum, count(*)::int AS pklt_cnt, mode() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY emd_cd) AS emd_cd FROM p GROUP BY 1, 2
), d AS ( SELECT floor(ST_X(ST_Transform(geom, 5179)) / #{gridSz}::float8)::bigint AS gx, floor(ST_Y(ST_Transform(geom, 5179)) / #{gridSz}::float8)::bigint AS gy, count(*) FILTER (WHERE crdn_mthd IN ('고정형CCTV', '주행형CCTV', '버스장착형CCTV'))::int AS n_fixed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE crdn_mthd = 'PDA')::int AS n_pda, count(*) FILTER (WHERE crdn_mthd IS NULL OR crdn_mthd NOT IN ('고정형CCTV', '주행형CCTV', '버스장착형CCTV', 'PDA'))::int AS n_manual FROM parking.tb_crdn_dsctn WHERE lat BETWEEN 33.10 AND 33.65 AND lot BETWEEN 126.10 AND 127.00 AND crdn_dt >= #{bgngDt} AND crdn_dt < #{endDtExcl} GROUP BY 1, 2 ), c AS ( SELECT floor(ST_X(ST_Transform(geom, 5179)) / #{gridSz}::float8)::bigint AS gx, floor(ST_Y(ST_Transform(geom, 5179)) / #{gridSz}::float8)::bigint AS gy, count(*)::int AS cvlcpt_cnt FROM parking.tb_cvlcpt WHERE lat BETWEEN 33.10 AND 33.65 AND lot BETWEEN 126.10 AND 127.00 AND ocrn_dt >= #{bgngDt} AND ocrn_dt < #{endDtExcl} GROUP BY 1, 2 ) SELECT q.*, CASE WHEN zc.zone_nm_src IN ('POI', 'REVERSE_GEOCODE') THEN zc.zone_nm END AS cache_zone_nm FROM ( SELECT sup.gx, sup.gy, sup.pklt_cpcty_sum, sup.pklt_cnt,
coalesce(d.n_fixed, 0) AS n_fixed, coalesce(d.n_pda, 0) AS n_pda, coalesce(d.n_manual, 0) AS n_manual, coalesce(c.cvlcpt_cnt, 0) AS cvlcpt_cnt, sup.emd_cd, ad.sgg_nm, ad.emd_nm,
round(ST_Y(ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint( sup.gx * #{gridSz}::float8 + #{gridSz}::float8 / 2, sup.gy * #{gridSz}::float8 + #{gridSz}::float8 / 2), 5179), 4326))::numeric, 7) AS ctr_lat, round(ST_X(ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint( sup.gx * #{gridSz}::float8 + #{gridSz}::float8 / 2, sup.gy * #{gridSz}::float8 + #{gridSz}::float8 / 2), 5179), 4326))::numeric, 7) AS ctr_lot,
ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_Transform(ST_MakeEnvelope( sup.gx * #{gridSz}::float8, sup.gy * #{gridSz}::float8, (sup.gx + 1) * #{gridSz}::float8, (sup.gy + 1) * #{gridSz}::float8, 5179), 4326)) AS ring_json FROM sup LEFT JOIN d ON d.gx = sup.gx AND d.gy = sup.gy LEFT JOIN c ON c.gx = sup.gx AND c.gy = sup.gy LEFT JOIN parking.tb_admdst ad ON ad.emd_cd = sup.emd_cd WHERE sup.pklt_cpcty_sum > 0
AND sup.emd_cd = #{emdCd} AND sup.emd_cd LIKE #{sggCd} || '%' ) q
LEFT JOIN parking.tb_zone_nm_cache zc ON zc.lat_key = round(q.ctr_lat, 5) AND zc.lot_key = round(q.ctr_lot, 5) ORDER BY q.gx, q.gy

SELECT to_char(min(crdn_dt), 'YYYYMMDD') AS data_bgng_ymd, to_char(max(crdn_dt), 'YYYYMMDD') AS data_end_ymd FROM parking.tb_crdn_dsctn WHERE lat BETWEEN 33.10 AND 33.65 AND lot BETWEEN 126.10 AND 127.00
